name: Caffeine Calculator
description: Public form that estimates caffeine intake from a chosen drink, amount, age, weight and medical conditions.
project_description:
Comprehensive tools to assess and optimize your health metrics.

 Note: This is just an indicator you should not rely on it for health advice.

 
 Contains submodules:

Caffeine Calculator

Will add others soon

 Features 
 Submodules:

 
 Caffeine Calculator Module

Allows to configure a list of drinks along with their amount of caffeine (/admin/config/tools/caffeine-calculator).

Provide a form (/body-calculators/caffeine-calculator) to select a drink and it will calculate the amount of caffeine in that drink based on the entered size and a recommendation for the daily amount of caffeine based on Age, weight, and restricted medical condition.
